verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a documented llms.txt indexing structure (llms.txt, llms-guides.txt, llms-api.txt, llms-full.txt, OpenAPI spec) explicitly designed for LLM/agent consumption, and a live probe confirms HTTP 200 with machine-readable usage instructions. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of an agent actually consuming these files in a real workflow.
